Search should operate over normalized display name, category, source pack, variant labels, and creator-safe tags. It should not require a model call. Results remain filtered to the active secondary category unless the UI explicitly enters global search.

## **25.6 Asset-pack awareness**

Hytale asset packs may extend content, so the catalog must identify source pack and tolerate options being removed between sessions. A saved skin referencing a missing cosmetic is displayed as Missing/Invalid with recovery options; it is not silently replaced on load. \[H12\]

# **26\. Skin Domain Model, Adapter, and Draft**

![NPC appearance editor pipeline from CosmeticRegistry catalog through PlayerSkin draft, preview, validation, and save.][image10]

**Figure 10\. Appearance editing uses a registry-backed draft, explicit PlayerSkin adapter, validated preview, and atomic NPC-targeted save.**

Hytale exposes similarly named skin representations across protocol and server cosmetics packages. Add an explicit adapter boundary and fully qualify types at integration points. Community documentation warns against casually mixing these representations. \[C2\]

## **26.1 Canonical adapter**

interface NpcSkinCodecAdapter {  
    NpcSkinDocument read(Path authoritativeSkinFile);  
    ProtocolPlayerSkin toProtocolSkin(NpcSkinDocument document);  
    NpcSkinDocument fromProtocolSkin(  
        ProtocolPlayerSkin skin,  
        NpcSkinDocument extensionPreservingBase  
    );  
    SkinValidationReport validate(ProtocolPlayerSkin skin);  
    String canonicalHash(NpcSkinDocument document);  
}

## **26.2 Appearance draft**

record NpcAppearanceDraft(  
    UUID draftId,  
    UUID sessionId,  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    long baseSkinRevision,  
    String baseSkinHash,  
    ProtocolPlayerSkin skin,  
    Set\<CosmeticFieldPath\> dirtyFields,  
    CosmeticSelectionContext selection,  
    SkinValidationReport validation,  
    long previewGeneration,  
    Optional\<ProtocolPlayerSkin\> resetSnapshot  
) {}

## **26.3 Draft rules**

* Opening clones the authoritative saved skin into a draft.  
* Every selection produces a new immutable or safely copied draft value.  
* Invalid selection never replaces the last valid draft.  
* Randomize modifies the draft only and retains a reset/undo snapshot.  
* Cancel restores authoritative preview and discards the draft.  
* Save Appearance is the only path that changes the saved NPC skin and live NPC appearance.

## **26.4 Extension preservation**

If the current skin JSON contains fields not represented by protocol PlayerSkin, preserve them through the adapter when safe. The adapter must not discard project-specific metadata merely because the appearance editor changes one haircut or color.

## **26.5 Missing options**

When a saved cosmetic ID is absent from the current catalog, retain the original ID in the draft/document, mark the field unresolved, and prevent blind save unless the creator explicitly selects a replacement or the current validator confirms the missing ID is still legal.

# **27\. Appearance UX, Search, Pagination, and Colors**

The custom editor should preserve the mental model of Hytale's native avatar creator: primary categories, secondary categories, an option grid, color swatches, a large preview, and clear Randomize/Cancel/Save actions. It need not reproduce the native client page byte-for-byte.

## **27.1 Window regions**

| Region | Purpose |
| :---- | :---- |
| Header | NPC APPEARANCE \- \[NAME\], close, dirty/validation indicator |
| Primary category rail | Body, Face, Hair, Eyes, Clothing, Accessories |
| Secondary category rail | Registry-backed subcategories for selected primary category |
| Search and filter | Debounced text search, source-pack filter if needed |
| Option grid | Paginated or virtualized cosmetic choices with selected and incompatible states |
| Color area | Valid tint/gradient/variant choices for selected option |
| Preview area | Large draft NPC preview over gold background, optional rotate/reset controls |
| Bottom actions | Randomize | Reset | Cancel | Save Appearance |

## **27.2 Option selection**

64. Creator selects a primary and secondary category.  
65. Catalog service returns the first bounded page of options.  
66. Creator selects one option.  
67. Draft service applies the option to a copy and validates it.  
68. If valid, increment preview generation and schedule one preview update.  
69. If invalid, retain current draft and show a human-readable compatibility reason.  
70. Color/variant controls update to only the choices valid for the selected option.

## **27.3 Pagination and virtualization**

* Do not render hundreds of option cards simultaneously.  
* Use a fixed card grid and page controls or virtualized rows supported by current Custom UI.  
* Cache display descriptors, not mutable preview models.  
* Preload the next page only when inexpensive and cancellable.  
* Maintain selection when search/filter changes if the option remains visible/valid.

## **27.4 Colors and gradients**

Render only colors/gradients/variants actually exposed by the cosmetic data. Do not synthesize arbitrary RGB values unless the current Hytale cosmetic contract supports free tinting. Selected color must be encoded in the same skin representation used by validation and preview, not as separate UI-only state.

## **27.5 Randomize and Reset**

* Randomize uses the supported Hytale cosmetics randomization path where available, then validates the result.  
* Randomize should respect locked fields in a future extension; version 1 may randomize all supported appearance fields.  
* Reset restores the last persisted skin captured at editor open or after the last successful save.  
* Neither action changes the live NPC until Save Appearance.

## **27.6 Accessibility and readability**

* Selected state uses border/icon/text in addition to color.  
* Every option card has a readable name tooltip.  
* Incompatible options show a reason, not only a gray tint.  
* Search results and category controls remain keyboard/controller reachable where current Custom UI permits.

# **28\. Appearance Preview, Validation, Save, and Rollback**

## **28.1 Preview update pipeline**

71. Receive validated draft selection.  
72. Increment previewGeneration and cancel/coalesce older pending preview work.  
73. Convert draft through NpcSkinCodecAdapter to the exact protocol/render representation.  
74. Create or update the preview model through the current supported cosmetics/preview path.  
75. Apply only if session, editor generation, draft hash, and preview generation still match.  
76. Retain authoritative live NPC appearance until Save Appearance.

## **28.2 Preview performance**

* Update on committed option click, not mouse hover.  
* Coalesce rapid selections to the newest draft.  
* Do not create dozens of models concurrently.  
* Reuse current preview component and proven viewer restoration sequence.  
* Fall back to textual selection if preview generation fails; do not lose the draft.

## **28.3 Save Appearance**

77. Revalidate session, writer lease, stable NPC ID, current skin revision/hash, and draft validity.  
78. Build extension-preserving skin document.  
79. Write and validate a temporary sibling file.  
80. Preserve rollback copy or prior content hash.  
81. Atomically replace authoritative NPC skin file.  
82. Increment skin revision and audit the commit.  
83. Apply saved skin to live NPC on world thread.  
84. Refresh main Gear preview and Profile Summary.  
85. Invalidate any skin/model cache owned by current runtime.  
86. Delete temporary files only after successful commit.

## **28.4 Rollback**

If file validation or atomic replacement fails, leave the prior authoritative skin untouched and keep the draft open. If persistence succeeds but live application fails, the saved file remains authoritative; mark live application degraded and retry/rebind rather than silently reverting the saved creator decision without evidence.

## **28.5 Connected acceptance**

* Change each supported category and verify preview.  
* Cancel and verify original appearance returns.  
* Save, close, reopen, and verify exact skin.  
* Restart server/world and verify exact skin.  
* Verify live NPC and studio preview agree.  
* Verify the logged-in player's avatar is unchanged after every close/error path.  
* Verify rapid category changes do not apply stale preview results.  
* Verify missing cosmetic/asset-pack removal produces explicit degraded state, not silent substitution.

# **29\. Cosmetic Thumbnail Strategy**

Thumbnail generation is the largest appearance-specific UI uncertainty. Do not block the architecture on reproducing native My Avatar thumbnails exactly.

## **29.1 Priority order**

87. Use an officially exposed cosmetic icon/thumbnail when the registry/asset provides one.  
88. Use a project-packaged category silhouette plus the option's readable name when no thumbnail exists.  
89. Use the large live preview as the definitive visual result.  
90. Defer generated 3D thumbnail rendering/cache to a separate stage only if usability requires it.

## **29.2 Deferred generated thumbnail cache**

A future thumbnail renderer must be asynchronous, versioned by Hytale build, cosmetic catalog identity, option/variant/color, model renderer version, and asset-pack set. It must not render the entire catalog synchronously when the editor opens. Cache invalidation and disk limits are mandatory.

## **29.3 License and asset handling**

Do not copy third-party cosmetic thumbnails into the mod without permission. Referenced assets remain owned by their source packs. The catalog may display officially exposed icons by their supported asset identifiers; project-authored fallback icons should ship with ImmersiveNPCs.

# **30\. Voice Recorder Feasibility and Capture Authority**

The Voice Recorder is feasible only if it reuses Hytale's inbound voice-frame API and the existing Orbis/Chatterbox asset pipeline. It is not a browser microphone widget. The current VoiceModule supports player voice interceptors and direct/entity/positional custom voice streams; exact methods and ordering must be verified against the installed build. \[H3-H5\]

PlayerVoiceInterceptor is invoked on a shared voice executor off the world thread and must return promptly without blocking, sleeping, file I/O, or contended locks. PlayerVoiceFrame is valid only during the interceptor call. The recorder must therefore copy only the opaque Opus bytes and minimal sequence/timestamp metadata into a bounded queue, then return. \[H3, H4\]

## **30.1 Recorder product boundary**

* Manual Record, Stop, Play, Delete, and Save Sample controls.  
* One selected canonical emotion per recording.  
* Clear red recording indicator and elapsed/maximum duration.  
* Private draft playback to the recording player.  
* Basic waveform or amplitude envelope generated off-thread.  
* Quality checks for silence, clipping, duration, channel/sample format, and file validity.  
* No trimming timeline, effects rack, multitrack recording, denoising suite, or mastering controls in version 1\.

## **30.2 Canonical emotion set**

| Emotion | Required? | Fallback/usage |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Reference | Required for voice profile | Neutral/Calm/Curious/Whispering and missing emotions fall back here under current mapping |
| Affectionate | Optional | Tender/Friendly map here |
| Amused | Optional | Humorous/light delivery |
| Excited | Optional | High-energy delivery |
| Angry | Optional | Anger/hostility delivery |
| Sad | Optional | Sad/grief delivery |
| Scared | Optional | Uneasy/Afraid map here |

## **30.3 Capture authority**

Introduce one capture-lease owner shared with the existing voice/conversation stack. The recorder cannot simply register a second independent microphone consumer, because the same frame could otherwise become both a voice sample and an NPC conversation.

enum VoiceCaptureMode {  
    NONE,  
    ORBIS\_CONVERSATION,  
    VOICE\_SAMPLE\_RECORDING  
}

* Only one capture mode may own a player's inbound voice at a time.  
* Starting a sample recording fails or pauses cleanly if conversation capture cannot release ownership.  
* While recording, frames must not enter Moonshine/STT, dialogue memory, relationship updates, or NPC floor ownership.  
* On stop, close, disconnect, or failure, the lease releases deterministically.

## **30.4 Privacy boundary**

The UI must clearly show when recording is active. Where current interceptor ordering permits, recorded frames should be dropped from ordinary proximity relay or delivered only to the recorder pipeline. Because later interceptors may change the audience, Codex must inspect registration priority and document whether private suppression is guaranteed or best-effort in the current build. \[H4\]

# **31\. Voice Capture Lease and Recording State Machine**

![Voice recorder pipeline from explicit record action through capture lease, non-blocking Opus queue, processing, playback, atomic save, and voice refresh.][image11]

**Figure 11\. Voice recording pipeline. The voice callback copies bounded frame data and returns; decoding, waveform work, playback preparation, and file writing run off-thread.**

## **31.1 Recording state machine**

| State | Allowed actions | Exit conditions |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| IDLE | Select emotion, Record, play/delete saved sample | Record requested |
| ARMED | Cancel | First valid frame, timeout, input disabled, cancel |
| RECORDING | Stop | Stop, max duration, disconnect, capture failure |
| FINALIZING | Cancel only if safe | Decode/analysis succeeds or fails |
| READY | Record Again, Play, Delete Draft, Save Sample | Action selected |
| PLAYING | Stop Playback | Playback complete/stop/close |
| SAVING | No conflicting action | Atomic save succeeds or fails |
| SAVED | Play, Record Again, Delete Saved | New action or close |
| FAILED | Retry, discard, close | Creator action |
| CANCELLED | None | Session disposal |

## **31.2 VoiceRecordingSession**

record VoiceRecordingSession(  
    UUID recordingId,  
    UUID authoringSessionId,  
    UUID playerId,  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    VoiceEmotion emotion,  
    long pageGeneration,  
    long editorGeneration,  
    long recordingGeneration,  
    Instant armedAt,  
    AtomicReference\<RecordingState\> state,  
    BoundedOpusFrameQueue queue,  
    RecordingLimits limits  
) {}

## **31.3 Interceptor algorithm**

91. Lookup active recording by speaker UUID using a thread-safe read path.  
92. If no recording is active, return immediately.  
93. Verify state is ARMED or RECORDING and generation still matches.  
94. Copy the opaque Opus payload and required sequence/timestamp fields while the frame is valid.  
95. Apply the chosen audience/drop policy using current interceptor priority.  
96. Offer the copied frame to a bounded queue without blocking.  
97. On queue overflow, increment a counter and transition/request failure according to limits.  
98. Return immediately. Do not touch ECS, files, decoder, waveform, model, or UI.

## **31.4 Recording limits**

| Limit | Initial policy | Reason |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Maximum duration | Configurable, conservative default aligned with existing voice validator | Bound memory and authoring time |
| Armed timeout | Fail if no frame arrives within a few seconds | Do not pretend microphone capture started |
| Queue bytes/frames | Hard bounded per recording | Protect shared voice executor and heap |
| Sequence gap tolerance | Record and assess; fail only beyond validated threshold | Handle packet loss without hiding unusable audio |
| Concurrent recordings | One per player; globally bounded | Protect CPU, storage, and voice routing |
| Temporary lifetime | Delete on session close/failure after bounded cleanup | Avoid orphaned private audio |

## **31.5 Start and stop semantics**

* **Record.** Validate permission, selected emotion, input settings, capture lease, and available temporary storage. Enter ARMED and show Waiting for microphone.  
* **First frame.** Transition to RECORDING and begin elapsed time according to the documented timing policy.  
* **Stop.** Atomically stop frame admission, release capture lease, freeze ordered frame list, and schedule finalization.  
* **Maximum duration.** Behave as an automatic Stop and tell the creator why.  
* **Close/disconnect.** Stop capture, release lease, invalidate generation, discard unsaved audio, and never auto-save.

## **31.6 Conversation isolation**

| VOICE ISOLATION. A sample recording must never create an NPC turn, STT transcript, episodic memory, belief, relationship delta, task, action, or canonical speech entry. Recorder playback must not feed back into the same capture path. |
| :---- |

# **32\. Audio Processing, Waveform, and Playback**

All audio processing begins after frame admission stops or through a bounded streaming worker that never blocks the voice executor. Reuse the current Orbis codec/audio utilities where available. Do not add a parallel decoder stack without first auditing the existing Direct Voice pipeline.

## **32.1 Finalization pipeline**

99. Sort/validate copied frames by sequence and timestamp.  
100. Detect duplicate, missing, or out-of-order frames and produce diagnostics.  
101. Decode Opus into PCM off-thread.  
102. Normalize channel layout and sample format to the existing voice-sample validator's required format.  
103. Compute duration, peak amplitude, clipping percentage, RMS/silence ratio, and bounded waveform envelope.  
104. Reject empty, too-short, too-long, corrupt, or severely clipped recordings according to explicit thresholds.  
105. Write only to a temporary draft file or memory-backed draft, never the final sample path.  
106. Transition to READY and update the UI if the session/generation still matches.

## **32.2 Waveform representation**

record WaveformEnvelope(  
    int bucketCount,  
    float\[\] peakAbs,  
    float\[\] rms,  
    Duration duration,  
    float clippingRatio,  
    float silenceRatio  
) {}

Use a bounded number of buckets suitable for the UI width. The waveform is diagnostic/presentation data, not the saved audio. Do not send full PCM or raw Opus bytes through Custom UI events.

## **32.3 Quality feedback**

| Finding | Player-facing guidance | Save behavior |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| No frames | No microphone audio was received. Check Hytale voice input. | Blocked |
| Too short | Record a longer sample with natural speech. | Blocked or warning per current validator |
| Long silence | Most of the recording is silent. | Warning/blocked by threshold |
| Clipping | The recording is too loud and may sound distorted. | Warning/blocked by threshold |
| Sequence gaps | The recording dropped audio frames. | Warning/blocked by severity |
| Valid | Ready | Save enabled |

## **32.4 Draft playback**

Playback of an unsaved draft should be private to the recording player. Prefer replaying the ordered original Opus frames through a direct VoiceSpeaker when that path is safe and preserves timing. If draft PCM must be re-encoded, reuse current codec infrastructure and perform encoding off-thread. Prevent recorder playback from being intercepted as a new recording or normal conversation.

## **32.5 Saved playback**

Playback of a saved sample should reuse the existing voice-sample preview path. Do not load the full Chatterbox model merely to preview a WAV. If only file-level playback exists, keep it separate from TTS conditioning and cache loading.

## **32.6 Playback lifecycle**

* One active recorder playback per session.  
* Stop prior playback when a new sample/emotion is selected.  
* Stop on close, disconnect, save replacement, delete, or plugin shutdown.  
* Late playback completion events may not alter a newer recording generation.

# **33\. Voice Save/Delete and Chatterbox Integration**

The existing voice profile and sample repository remains authoritative. The recorder produces a validated draft and delegates naming, path ownership, rescan, and conditioning-cache invalidation to the existing services. Chatterbox uses a reference audio prompt for voice cloning; the exact current Orbis sample format and duration validator remains authoritative over examples in external repositories. \[C3\]

## **33.1 Canonical file naming**

| Emotion | Example file |
| :---- | :---- |
| Reference | jonalith-reference.wav |
| Affectionate | jonalith-affectionate.wav |
| Amused | jonalith-amused.wav |
| Excited | jonalith-excited.wav |
| Angry | jonalith-angry.wav |
| Sad | jonalith-sad.wav |
| Scared | jonalith-scared.wav |

Use the existing profile/voice filename sanitizer and path resolver. Never concatenate an unsanitized display name into an arbitrary path. The target must remain inside the owning NPC voice directory after canonical path resolution.

## **33.2 Save Sample transaction**

107. Revalidate session, NPC stable ID, selected emotion, permission, base sample revision/hash, and draft validity.  
108. Resolve the canonical sample target through the existing voice repository.  
109. Write a temporary WAV beside the target.  
110. Close, reread, and run the existing voice-sample validator on the temporary file.  
111. Preserve the prior sample or its hash for rollback.  
112. Atomically replace the final sample.  
113. Increment per-emotion/sample revision and write authoring audit.  
114. Rescan the NPC voice profile.  
115. Invalidate Chatterbox conditioning/cache identity for the NPC/profile/sample revision.  
116. Refresh the Voice Samples table and readiness summary.  
117. Delete draft buffers and temporary files only after success.

## **33.3 Delete semantics**

| Action | Confirmation | Result |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Delete unsaved draft | Optional simple confirmation | Discard temporary audio only |
| Delete saved optional emotion | Confirm sample and emotion | Atomic delete/rename-to-trash, rescan, cache invalidation |
| Delete Reference | Strong warning that voice profile may become invalid | Only with explicit confirmation and permission |

## **33.4 Voice readiness**

* Reference missing: voice profile is Missing/Invalid according to current rules.  
* Optional emotion missing: fallback to Reference; table shows Missing without invalidating the entire profile.  
* Malformed sample: status Invalid with readable validator result.  
* Save success: table updates without requiring file browser or manual Rescan, though Rescan remains available.  
* Cache failure after valid save: sample remains authoritative; voice runtime reports degraded cache and retries under existing policy.

## **33.5 Rights and consent**

Recording is initiated by the player operating the UI and should display clear consent/recording state. Server operators remain responsible for obtaining appropriate rights for recorded voices and generated use. The studio should store creator/operator identity and timestamp in audit metadata without embedding personal data in the audio filename.

# **34\. Persistence, Revisions, Atomicity, and Migrations**

The studio spans four durable authorities: profile JSON, skin JSON, voice WAV files, and NPC inventory/gear persistence. These domains must not share one global Save button because their commit semantics and failure recovery differ.

![Commit semantics diagram comparing draft-based file domains with immediate item transaction domains.][image3]

**Figure 12\. Persistence and commit boundaries. Explicit-save domains use revisioned atomic file replacement; item domains use immediate native transactions and existing listeners.**

## **34.1 Revision registry**

record AuthoringDomainRevision(  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    AuthoringDomain domain,  
    Optional\<String\> subKey,  
    long revision,  
    String canonicalHash,  
    Instant committedAt,  
    UUID operationId  
) {}

* Profile has one revision/hash.  
* Appearance has one revision/hash.  
* Voice may use per-emotion sample revision/hash plus aggregate voice-profile revision.  
* Inventory/gear use current live state and repository snapshot sequence rather than a long-lived editor draft revision.  
* Every asynchronous result carries the base revision/hash it was generated from.

## **34.2 Atomic file protocol**

118. Resolve canonical path under the owning NPC directory.  
119. Validate path containment and permissions.  
120. Prepare temporary sibling file with unique operation ID.  
121. Write complete content and close stream.  
122. Reread and validate temporary content.  
123. Optionally fsync according to platform/repository policy.  
124. Preserve existing target through rollback copy or atomic replace semantics.  
125. Atomically replace target.  
126. Reread authoritative target, compute canonical hash, and update revision registry.  
127. Delete obsolete temporary/rollback files according to retention policy.

## **34.3 Hydration safety**

Any hydration that populates an initially empty live container must capture the pre-hydration state. If post-hydration canonical comparison fails, restore the exact pre-hydration state before returning failure. Canonical comparison normalizes only explicitly equivalent legacy representations, such as empty metadata forms already defined by the inventory domain.

## **34.4 Migration policy**

| Change type | Required migration behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| Profile schema adds field | Default absent field without discarding unknown extension data; record migration version |
| Appearance schema/API changes | Adapter migrates known fields; unresolved cosmetics stay explicit, not silently replaced |
| Voice naming/emotion mapping changes | Copy/rename only through migration manifest; preserve source and rollback |
| Inventory metadata canonicalization | Normalize equivalence for comparison and future save; never alter meaningful metadata |
| Gear/loadout model changes | Versioned conversion with lossless source snapshot and compatibility report |

## **34.5 Crash consistency**

* No partially written profile/skin/WAV may become authoritative.  
* An interrupted item transaction relies on Hytale's native transaction semantics and repository ordering.  
* A crash after file replace but before UI acknowledgment is resolved by rereading authority on reopen.  
* A stale queued inventory snapshot may not overwrite a later terminal flush.  
* Startup scans quarantine orphaned temporary files and report recovery options; they do not auto-promote unknown content.

## **34.6 Backup and retention**

Retain a bounded number of profile/skin/voice rollback artifacts per NPC or operation history according to configuration. Do not duplicate large audio indefinitely. Audit records should reference hashes and revisions so old content can be correlated without retaining every transient buffer.

# **35\. Threading, Scheduling, and Performance Budgets**

The authoring studio is server-driven but crosses multiple executors. Correctness requires explicit thread ownership, bounded queues, cancellation, and Hytale-first resource scheduling.

| Work | Required execution context | Budget/constraint |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Custom UI event decode | Current page callback; minimal | Validate envelope and enqueue/dispatch quickly |
| ECS identity/stat read | World thread | Immutable bounded snapshot only |
| Inventory/gear mutation | World thread/current required store thread | One native transaction, no blocking I/O |
| Preview apply | Current supported network/world path | Coalesced; reject stale generation |
| Profile generation | Orbis model worker/resource scheduler | Lower priority than active conversation; timeout/cancellable |
| Cosmetic catalog indexing | Worker if API-safe; otherwise bounded snapshot on allowed thread | Cache by build/pack identity |
| Voice interception | Voice executor | Copy/enqueue/return; no decode or I/O |
| Audio decode/WAV/waveform | Bounded audio worker | Memory and duration limits |
| Profile/skin/voice file preparation | I/O worker | Atomic protocol; authoritative apply returns to required thread |
| UI refresh | Custom page command path | Coalesce related fields; avoid full page rebuild for minor updates |

## **35.1 Resource priority**

128. Hytale server tick and mandatory gameplay work.  
129. Foreground player-NPC conversation and voice.  
130. Authoritative inventory/gear transactions and page reconciliation.  
131. Authoring preview updates and stats refresh.  
132. Profile Generate requests.  
133. Catalog prefetch, thumbnail cache, and nonessential analysis.

## **35.2 Initial performance budgets**

| Operation | Target behavior |
| :---- | :---- |
| Open base workspace | No long blocking model/audio work; render existing state promptly after identity and container binding |
| Inventory/gear move | One world-thread transaction and one coalesced authoritative refresh |
| Stats refresh | Event-driven or low-frequency; never per frame |
| Appearance option click | UI feedback immediate; newest preview wins; older jobs cancelled |
| Catalog search | Debounced and paginated |
| Generate | Asynchronous with visible progress/cancel; gameplay remains responsive |
| Voice interceptor | Prompt return; bounded enqueue only |
| Waveform | Bounded buckets; no full PCM in UI payload |

## **35.3 Backpressure**

* Only one active Generate request per Profile Editor; newer request cancels older.  
* Only one active appearance preview job per editor generation; coalesce to latest.  
* Voice frame queue has a hard capacity and fails visibly rather than expanding unbounded.  
* Catalog requests are paginated and stale search results are discarded.  
* UI refreshes are batched by operation ID/generation.

## **35.4 Warmup interaction**

The studio must not force full Orbis/Chatterbox warmup merely to browse inventory or appearance. Generate and voice-profile rescan may request the specific runtime they need through existing warmup/resource APIs. Manual profile editing and appearance selection should remain usable while models are unavailable.

# **36\. Permissions, Security, Privacy, and Threat Model**

Custom UI events, generated output, recorded voice, file paths, inventory sections, and cosmetic identifiers are untrusted until validated. The studio is an administrative/creator surface and must use explicit permissions.

## **36.1 Suggested permissions**

| Permission | Controls |
| :---- | :---- |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.open | Open studio and inspect permitted NPCs |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.profile | Edit and save profile |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.generate | Use model-assisted Generate |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.appearance | Edit and save appearance |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.voice | Record, play, save, and delete voice samples |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.inventory | Move NPC inventory items |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.gear | Equip/unequip/loadout changes |
| immersivenpcs.authoring.advanced | File browser, diagnostics, raw IDs, recovery tools |

## **36.2 Threats and controls**

| Threat | Control |
| :---- | :---- |
| Forged/stale UI event | Session ID, page/editor generation, viewer ownership, NPC stable ID, action allowlist |
| Arbitrary inventory access | Allowlist Player Storage and exact active NPC windows/containers by object identity |
| Item quantity spoof | Ignore client authority; reread source stack and derive quantity server-side |
| Wrong NPC mutation | Stable ID \+ current entity UUID/Ref \+ storage object identity \+ writer lease |
| Path traversal | Canonical root resolution and containment check for profile, skin, voice, temp, and rollback paths |
| Generated prompt injection | Structured output schema, field allowlist, no direct commands/actions, explicit human save |
| Voice recording without awareness | Visible recording state, deliberate Record action, permission, capture lease |
| Voice leakage | Interceptor audience/drop policy, private playback, no raw audio logs |
| Resource exhaustion | Text/audio length limits, queue limits, timeouts, concurrency caps, paginated catalogs |
| Revision overwrite | Base hash/revision compare and conflict UX |
| Secret/log leakage | No credentials, hidden reasoning, raw audio, or unnecessary personal content in traces |

## **36.3 Generated-content security**

* Generation output cannot select paths, stable IDs, permissions, inventories, gear, or executable actions.  
* Strip/reject markup or control syntax capable of escaping the intended profile field representation.  
* Do not accept a generated JSON blob directly into profile persistence.  
* Model/provider failures cannot disable manual editing.  
* Generated content provenance remains visible to operators and auditable after save.

## **36.4 Voice privacy**

* Do not store raw voice in logs or audit records.  
* Temporary audio is deleted on cancel/close/failure after bounded cleanup.  
* Playback is private to the creator unless an explicit future share function is added.  
* Recording should not occur when voice input is disabled or when capture ownership cannot be established.  
* Document the limits of suppression if another interceptor can reroute a dropped frame.

## **36.5 Asset and license boundary**

Use official Hytale APIs and project-authored assets. Community Wardrobe is an architectural reference under AGPL-3.0 and must not be copied into a non-compatible project without license review. Chatterbox code/model terms and voice rights must be retained in deployment documentation. \[C1, C3\]

# **37\. Failure Handling and Recovery**

Failures should be contained to the smallest owning domain. A voice decoder failure must not close inventory; a Generate timeout must not invalidate manual profile edits; an appearance preview failure must not corrupt the saved skin.

| Failure | Containment | Recovery |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Profile validation error | Profile draft only | Keep draft open, mark fields, no file write |
| Profile revision conflict | Profile save blocked | Reload/rebase or preserve draft recovery |
| Generate timeout/malformed output | Generation feature only | Discard proposal, retain manual draft |
| Cosmetic catalog unavailable | Appearance editor degraded | Show saved skin and retry catalog; other domains remain usable |
| Appearance preview failure | Draft preview only | Retain valid draft, rebuild preview, no live mutation |
| Skin save failure | Appearance commit blocked | Prior file/live skin retained; draft remains |
| No voice frames | Recording attempt only | Release lease, show input guidance, no file |
| Voice queue overflow/decode failure | Recording attempt only | Discard invalid draft, preserve saved sample |
| Inventory stale source | One move rejected | Refresh grids from authority |
| Gear incompatible/full displacement | One gear move rejected | Refresh gear/inventory; no mutation |
| Persistence flush failure | Owning domain critical | Keep session/error visible; retain retry/rollback evidence |
| NPC unload | Live domains unavailable | Disable live controls; require rebind/reopen |
| Player disconnect/page close | Whole session | Invalidate generations, stop capture/playback, discard drafts, flush items |

## **37.1 Idempotent close**

134. Mark session closing and stop admitting events.  
135. Invalidate page/editor/recording/preview generations.  
136. Cancel Generate/catalog/preview/audio jobs.  
137. Stop voice capture and playback; release capture lease.  
138. Discard unsaved profile/appearance/voice drafts.  
139. Unregister inventory/stat/voice listeners.  
140. Terminally flush current inventory/gear persistence.  
141. Restore viewer preview/model/skin/equipment state.  
142. Release NPC writer lease and session registry entry.  
143. Log final cleanup counts. Repeated close calls do nothing harmful.

## **37.2 Recovery artifacts**

Temporary profile/skin/voice files and rollback copies use operation IDs and remain under dedicated roots. Startup recovery scans may quarantine orphaned artifacts and report them; they must not silently promote a temporary file over a valid authoritative file.

## **37.3 Fail-open versus fail-closed**

| Concern | Policy |
| :---- | :---- |
| Profile/skin/voice save | Fail closed: no authority change on validation/conflict/write failure |
| Inventory/gear mutation | Fail closed: no manual fallback copy; refresh authority |
| Stats unavailable | Fail open for other editor features; show unavailable |
| Generate unavailable | Fail open for manual profile editing |
| Appearance preview unavailable | Fail open for draft editing only if selections can still be validated; otherwise read-only |
| Voice privacy cannot be guaranteed | Fail closed for recording unless operator policy explicitly accepts documented limitation |

# **38\. Observability and Diagnostics**

Diagnostics must make it possible to trace one authoring action from UI intent through validation, native mutation or file commit, UI refresh, and persistence without exposing raw technical codes to ordinary creators.

## **38.1 Operation correlation**

AuthoringOperationContext  
  operationId  
  sessionId  
  viewerPlayerId  
  npcStableId  
  pageGeneration  
  editorKind  
  editorGeneration  
  domainRevisionBefore

## **38.2 Structured markers**

| Prefix | Examples |
| :---- | :---- |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_SESSION\_\* | OPEN, READY, EDITOR\_SWITCH, CLOSING, CLOSED, REJECTED |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_PROFILE\_\* | DRAFT, GENERATE\_REQUEST, PROPOSAL, VALIDATION, SAVE, CONFLICT |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_APPEARANCE\_\* | CATALOG, SELECT, PREVIEW, VALIDATION, SAVE, APPLY |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_VOICE\_\* | ARMED, FRAME\_DROP\_COUNT, FINALIZE, PLAYBACK, SAVE, DELETE |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_ITEM\_\* | INTENT, VALIDATED, NATIVE\_MOVE, RESULT, REFRESH, DUPLICATE |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_STATS\_\* | SNAPSHOT, UNAVAILABLE, REFRESH |
| NPC\_AUTHORING\_RECOVERY\_\* | TEMP\_QUARANTINE, ROLLBACK, FLUSH\_FAILURE, CLEANUP |

## **38.3 Trace contents**

* Stable IDs, revisions, hashes, section/slot IDs, operation result, timings, and typed rejection reason.  
* Before/after item summaries sufficient to prove quantity and identity without dumping sensitive arbitrary metadata.  
* Generated proposal field paths and hashes, not hidden reasoning.  
* Voice frame counts, gaps, duration, clipping/silence metrics, and file hashes, not raw audio.  
* Preview/catalog generations and stale-result rejection.  
* Cleanup/lease/listener counts.

## **38.4 Developer UI**

Developer mode may expose stable IDs, revisions, provider status, file hashes, live binding identity, and raw technical rejection codes. Normal mode uses human-readable status. Do not make developer diagnostics part of the profile canon or prompt.

# **39\. Test Architecture and Connected Validation**

Automated tests prove contracts, serialization, permissions, revisions, and server-side state. Connected Hytale tests remain authoritative for Custom UI hit testing, cursor reconciliation, preview behavior, microphone delivery, private playback, UI scale, and native item semantics.

## **39.1 Test layers**

| Layer | Purpose | Examples |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| Unit | Pure domain rules | Draft diff, canonical hash, validation, compatibility, filename/path containment |
| Component | Repository/service behavior | Atomic save, revision conflict, catalog cache, voice queue, item policy |
| Fault injection | Rollback and cancellation | Write failure, stale generation, decoder failure, queue overflow, provider timeout |
| Deterministic integration | Cross-service contracts without client | Session registry, bridge validation, profile/skin/voice commit flow |
| Connected client | Real Custom UI and Hytale runtime behavior | Inventory drag, preview, category UI, microphone, playback, scaling |
| Soak | Long-run convergence and resource cleanup | 100+ item ops, repeated editor navigation, recording cycles |

## **39.2 Base workspace connected matrix**

* 1920 x 1080 and 2560 x 1440\.  
* Supported UI scale settings.  
* Long and short NPC/player names.  
* Spawned and non-spawned target.  
* Open, contextual editor switch, Cancel, close, reconnect, and repeated reopen.  
* Preview restoration and no Player appearance/equipment mutation.  
* Square inventory/gear slots and no panel overlap/clipping.

## **39.3 Inventory and gear matrix**

| Case | Required result |
| :---- | :---- |
| Player internal / NPC internal | Correct authoritative rearrangement and refresh |
| Player \<-\> NPC full stack | Correct bidirectional ownership, quantity, metadata, persistence |
| Partial split / one item | Matches proven Hytale semantics |
| Merge | Native max stack/remainder |
| Occupied swap | Atomic legal swap or clean rejection |
| Quick move arrows/shift | One selected stack, deterministic destination, no Take All |
| Full destination | Reject, retain source, readable message |
| Incompatible armor/loadout | Reject before mutation, explain slot |
| Unequip to full storage | Reject without deletion/world drop |
| Close while carrying | Authoritative/UI convergence, no ghost item |
| NPC unload/switch/stale event | No wrong-NPC mutation |
| Restart | Exact inventory/gear/visibility/ammo policy persists |
| 100+ mixed operations | Zero loss, duplication, stale cursor, wrong slot/section |

## **39.4 Profile generation matrix**

* Manual edit/save/reopen/restart.  
* Generate returns structured allowed fields only.  
* Generated proposal does not save automatically.  
* Accept selected fields, edit proposal, discard proposal.  
* Stale proposal rejected after draft changes or editor close.  
* Provider timeout/unavailable leaves manual draft intact.  
* Unknown profile fields survive save.  
* Revision conflict preserves draft and blocks overwrite.  
* Saved generated text is marked reviewed provenance and appears in later Orbis profile context only after save.

## **39.5 Appearance matrix**

* Every exposed category and color/variant path.  
* Search, pagination, selected state, incompatible state.  
* Rapid selections and stale preview cancellation.  
* Randomize, Reset, Cancel, Save.  
* Save/reopen/restart and live NPC/main preview parity.  
* Missing cosmetic after asset-pack change.  
* No logged-in Player avatar mutation.  
* No discarded unknown skin extension data.

## **39.6 Voice matrix**

| Case | Required result |
| :---- | :---- |
| Input disabled / no frames | Clear failure, lease released, no file |
| Reference and each emotion | Record, finalize, play, save, table refresh |
| Silence / clipping / too short | Quality result and save policy |
| Max duration | Automatic stop and bounded processing |
| Rapid Record/Stop | Valid state transitions, no stuck lease |
| Close/disconnect while recording | Capture stops, temp deleted, no auto-save |
| Private playback | Only creator hears; no recorder feedback |
| Conversation isolation | No STT, memory, relationship, or NPC response |
| Replace/delete sample | Atomic, confirmation, rescan, cache invalidation |
| Reference delete | Strong warning and resulting readiness correct |
| Repeated cycles | No leaked buffers, speakers, files, or registrations |

## **39.7 Critical invariants asserted by tests**

* UI never writes authority directly.  
* One session/editor/capture lease owner at a time.  
* Stable NPC identity and domain revisions are checked at every mutation boundary.  
* No generated proposal reaches canon before Save Profile.  
* No voice draft reaches final path before validation and Save Sample.  
* No inventory/gear operation uses manual copy/delete.  
* No asynchronous stale result updates the current session.  
* Every failed commit leaves prior authority intact or restores pre-operation state.

# **40\. Bounded Implementation Program**

Implement in eight stages A0-A7. Codex may combine adjacent repository work where practical, but activation and connected gates remain separate. A later stage cannot claim completion while an earlier required gate is red.

![Bounded implementation stages A0 through A7 and safe consolidation rules.][image12]

**Figure 13\. Bounded implementation program. Safe consolidation accelerates coding without collapsing evidence or promotion gates.**

## **40.1 Stage A0 \- Repository audit and production freeze**

* Inspect current revision, current Npc Profile layout, inventory bridge capabilities, gear/loadout owners, skin/preview path, voice sample repository, Orbis model scheduler, voice interception, stats, permissions, and persistence.  
* Record installed Hytale client/server build and relevant API signatures.  
* Hash current production classes/assets/JAR and preserve rollback.  
* Run current deterministic and connected baseline relevant to NPC Profile.  
* Produce ownership map and gap report. Do not change behavior.

Exit gate: current behavior proven, ownership resolved, rollback valid, no production mutation.

## **40.2 Stage A1 \- Unified session and floating workspace shell**

* Implement NpcAuthoringSessionRegistry, writer lease, event envelope, panel manager, base panel separation, responsive profiles, contextual editor host, scrim, and navigation.  
* Package NPC background and weapon/offhand/ammo icons.  
* Keep current inventory, preview, gear shell, profile summary, voice table, and persistence behavior unchanged.  
* Contextual editors may show bounded placeholders only.

Connected exit gate: workspace opens at target resolutions, panels do not overlap, slots remain square, current inventory transfers and preview restoration remain green.

## **40.3 Stage A2 \- Complete coupled inventory**

* Generalize the production item bridge.  
* Enable internal moves, merge, atomic swap or rejection, partial split, quick move, transfer arrows, stale/replay handling, and readable errors.  
* Retain native ItemContainer/InventoryUtils authority and explicit UI reconciliation.  
* Run full mixed-operation and restart persistence matrix.

Exit gate: complete storage matrix and 100+ operation soak with zero loss, duplication, ghost item, stale cursor, wrong slot/section, or wrong NPC.

## **40.4 Stage A3 \- Gear, loadout, and live stats**

* Implement compatibility resolver and equipment endpoints.  
* Enable armor, Primary Weapon, Shield/Offhand, Preferred Ammunition, Infinite Ammunition, visibility controls, EquipmentUpdate, live preview, and stats snapshot.  
* Keep occupied/full destination behavior atomic or fail closed.  
* Persist and verify restart behavior.

Exit gate: every supported equip/unequip direction, compatibility, displacement, preview/live parity, stats refresh, and persistence pass with zero item loss.

## **40.5 Stage A4 \- Profile Editor and Generate**

* Implement schema-preserving draft editor, validation, revision conflicts, Generate service, structured proposal/diff, provenance, atomic Save Profile, and summary refresh.  
* Do not change Orbis truth, memory, relationship, or speech ownership.  
* Evaluate generated output with bounded fixtures and connected manual scenarios.

Exit gate: manual and generated-reviewed save flows survive close/reopen/restart; unknown fields and canon boundaries remain intact.

## **40.6 Stage A5 \- NPC Appearance Editor**

* Implement current-build cosmetics audit, catalog service, PlayerSkin adapter, category rails, search/pagination, colors/variants, draft validation, preview, randomize/reset/cancel/save, live apply, and rollback.  
* Use placeholders when thumbnails are unavailable.  
* Never mutate Player avatar.

Exit gate: all categories and lifecycle cases pass; saved skin survives restart and live NPC/main preview agree.

## **40.7 Stage A6 \- Voice Recorder**

* Implement capture lease, interceptor, bounded queue, state machine, off-thread decode/analysis, waveform, private playback, save/delete, rescan, cache invalidation, and privacy/consent UI.  
* Reuse existing Direct Voice/Chatterbox assets and codec ownership.  
* Test all emotions and lifecycle failures.

Exit gate: real connected microphone capture, private playback, save/reopen/restart, conversation isolation, and repeated-cycle resource cleanup pass.

## **40.8 Stage A7 \- Full integration and polish**

* Create a new NPC entirely in game and update an existing NPC through all domains.  
* Verify Orbis consumes the saved profile, appearance, voice, inventory, gear, and stats context correctly.  
* Run cross-domain stale-session, concurrent editor, disconnect, unload/reload, provider unavailable, missing asset, and persistence failure scenarios.  
* Polish spacing, responsive scaling, tooltips, localization, accessibility, and footer help.  
* Decide whether the native inventory fallback may be retired; retain it if any Custom UI path remains less reliable.

Exit gate: complete Definition of Done, full deterministic suite, connected matrix, soak, one production JAR, documented rollback.

## **40.9 Safe stage consolidation**

| Combined Codex pass | Permitted | Mandatory stop |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| A0 \+ A1 | Yes. Audit/freeze and shell/session implementation can be one repository session. | Do not deploy shell if baseline or ownership audit is unresolved. |
| A2 \+ A3 implementation | Yes, shared bridge/compatibility code may be built together. | Do not activate gear until storage completion gate is green. |
| A4 | Prefer independent. | Do not proceed if schema preservation or canon provenance is unresolved. |
| A5 | Prefer independent. | Do not proceed if current cosmetics API/adapter cannot validate and round-trip. |
| A6 | Independent. | Do not proceed if capture privacy/threading cannot be bounded. |
| A7 | Final only. | No integration claim while any domain gate remains connected-pending. |

## **40.10 Required stage report**

Maintain NPC\_AUTHORING\_STUDIO\_TECHNICAL\_DESIGN\_AND\_IMPLEMENTATION\_REPORT.md with stage status, current revision, automated gate, connected gate, deployed/rollback JAR hashes, ownership decisions, files/classes/assets changed, known limitations, and next allowed stage.

# **41\. Definition of Done**

The NPC Authoring Studio is complete only when a creator can perform the entire workflow in game and every domain remains authoritative, durable, reversible, and correctly consumed by Orbis.

144. Run /npc create \[name\] and receive one valid authoring session.  
145. See separate Gear/Stats and Profile panels plus one coupled Inventory panel with square native-style slots.  
146. Move, rearrange, split, merge, swap, and quick-move items between Player and NPC without loss or duplication.  
147. Equip and remove armor, Primary Weapon, Shield/Offhand, and Preferred Ammunition through validated native transactions.  
148. Configure Infinite Ammunition without generating or duplicating visible stacks.  
149. See the studio preview, live NPC equipment, and authoritative live stats update.  
150. Open Profile Editor, manually define the NPC, and preserve unknown profile data.  
151. Select Generate, review/edit a structured proposal, and save only through Save Profile.  
152. Confirm generated text becomes authored canon only after save and never becomes memory/world truth by itself.  
153. Open NPC Appearance, browse the Hytale-backed catalog, select cosmetics/colors, preview, cancel/reset/randomize, and save directly to the NPC.  
154. Verify the Player avatar never changes.  
155. Open Voice Recorder, record, stop, privately play, delete, and save Reference and emotional samples.  
156. Verify recorded speech never becomes an NPC conversation or memory.  
157. Close/reopen and restart the server; confirm profile, skin, voice, inventory, gear, visibility, ammo policy, and stats-relevant equipment remain correct.  
158. Converse with the NPC and confirm Orbis uses the saved profile and voice.  
159. Complete the workflow without raw JSON editing, player-avatar export, Audacity, or manual file movement.  
160. Pass all deterministic, fault-injection, connected Hytale, resolution/UI-scale, and soak gates.  
161. Finish with zero item loss, duplication, wrong-NPC mutation, stale preview, leaked capture, uncommitted canon, or partial-file corruption.

| FINAL AUTHORITY CHECK. A feature is done only when the creator-facing UI, authoritative server state, durable persistence, live NPC representation, and Orbis consumption all agree after close, reconnect, unload/reload, and server restart. |
| :---- |

# **Appendix A. Proposed Component Map**

Names are normative responsibilities, not mandatory exact class names. Codex must map them onto the current repository and avoid introducing a duplicate when an equivalent owner already exists.

| Package area | Component | Responsibility |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| ui | NpcAuthoringStudioPage | InteractiveCustomUIPage shell; build, event dispatch, close lifecycle |
| ui | NpcAuthoringPanelManager | Floating panel visibility, geometry profile, scrim, contextual editor host |
| ui | NpcAuthoringUiRenderer | Typed UI patches from immutable view models |
| ui | NpcAuthoringEventCodec | Versioned central Custom UI event envelope |
| session | NpcAuthoringSession | Viewer/NPC/page/editor identity, revisions, leases, dirty state |
| session | NpcAuthoringSessionRegistry | One session per player and one writer lease per NPC |
| session | NpcAuthoringWriterLease | Exclusive authoring lease and conflict metadata |
| profile | NpcProfileDraftService | Clone, edit, reset, validate, preserve unknown fields |
| profile | NpcProfilePersistenceService | Revision check and atomic profile save |
| profile | NpcProfileGenerationService | Asynchronous provider-neutral structured proposal generation |
| profile | GeneratedProfileProposalValidator | Allowlist, budgets, schema, fact-preservation checks |
| profile | ProfileCanonPromotionService | Existing profile/canon ingestion and cache invalidation adapter |
| appearance | NpcAppearanceCatalogService | CosmeticRegistry snapshot, search, pagination, variants/colors |
| appearance | NpcSkinCodecAdapter | Explicit stored/server/protocol PlayerSkin conversion and hash |
| appearance | NpcAppearanceDraftService | Draft selections, validation, randomize/reset, dirty fields |
| appearance | NpcAppearancePreviewService | Coalesced draft preview generation/application |
| appearance | NpcAppearancePersistenceService | Atomic skin save, rollback, live apply |
| voice | VoiceCaptureLeaseManager | Mutual exclusion between conversation and sample recording |
| voice | NpcVoiceRecordingService | Recording state machine and active session registry |
| voice | BoundedOpusFrameQueue | Per-recording bounded copied-frame queue |
| voice | VoiceDraftProcessor | Decode, PCM normalization, silence/clipping, waveform, temp WAV |
| voice | VoiceDraftPlaybackService | Private playback and lifecycle |
| voice | NpcVoiceSamplePersistenceService | Canonical naming, atomic save/delete, rescan, cache invalidation |
| item | AuthoritativeItemMoveBridge | Shared validation, replay protection, native move, reread, refresh |

## **A.1 Suggested package layout**

com.inigmasgames.persistentnpcs.authoring  
  /ui  
  /session  
  /profile  
  /appearance  
  /voice  
  /item  
  /gear  
  /stats  
  /persistence  
  /audit  
  /security  
  /integration  
  /diagnostics

Do not force every component into a new package if current repository ownership would be clearer by extending an existing profile, voice, inventory, or UI package. The key requirement is dependency direction: UI \-\> session/domain service \-\> current authority adapter, never authority \-\> UI.

# **Appendix B. Normative Data Contracts**

These contracts define required information and trust boundaries. Exact Java records/codecs may differ to match the repository's serialization conventions.

## **B.1 Central UI event envelope**

record NpcAuthoringEvent(  
    String schemaVersion,  
    UUID sessionId,  
    long pageGeneration,  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    NpcAuthoringEditorKind editorKind,  
    long editorGeneration,  
    String action,  
    String target,  
    String rawPayload  
) {}

* All values are untrusted until resolved against the active session.  
* Server-authored event bindings should provide constants such as target domain and destination section where possible.  
* Unknown schema version or action fails closed.

## **B.2 Session**

final class NpcAuthoringSession {  
    NpcAuthoringSessionIdentity identity;  
    AuthoringSessionState state;  
    NpcAuthoringEditorKind activeEditor;  
    Optional\<NpcProfileDraft\> profileDraft;  
    Optional\<NpcAppearanceDraft\> appearanceDraft;  
    Optional\<VoiceRecordingSession\> voiceDraft;  
    AuthoritativeInventoryBinding inventoryBinding;  
    AuthoritativeEquipmentBinding equipmentBinding;  
    AuthoringDomainRevisionSnapshot revisions;  
    PreviewOwnership previewOwnership;  
    Optional\<VoiceCaptureLease\> voiceCaptureLease;  
    DirtyDomainSet dirty;  
    boolean closing;  
}

## **B.3 Inventory binding**

record AuthoritativeInventoryBinding(  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    UUID npcEntityUuid,  
    ObjectIdentity playerStorageIdentity,  
    ObjectIdentity npcStorageIdentity,  
    int playerStorageSectionId,  
    int npcStorageWindowSectionId,  
    long bindingGeneration  
) {}

## **B.4 Equipment binding**

record AuthoritativeEquipmentBinding(  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    UUID npcEntityUuid,  
    ObjectIdentity armorContainerIdentity,  
    ObjectIdentity loadoutContainerIdentity,  
    Map\<ArmorSlot, Integer\> armorSlotIndexes,  
    Map\<LoadoutSlot, Integer\> loadoutSlotIndexes,  
    long equipmentRevision  
) {}

## **B.5 Move result**

record AuthoringItemMoveResult(  
    UUID operationId,  
    ItemMoveResultKind kind,  
    Optional\<ItemMoveRejectionReason\> rejection,  
    AuthoritativeContainerSnapshot sourceAfter,  
    AuthoritativeContainerSnapshot targetAfter,  
    Optional\<EquipmentSnapshot\> equipmentAfter,  
    Optional\<NpcStatsSnapshot\> statsAfter,  
    long uiRefreshGeneration  
) {}

## **B.6 Profile proposal**

record GeneratedProfileProposal(  
    UUID proposalId,  
    UUID requestId,  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    long baseProfileRevision,  
    String sourceDraftHash,  
    Map\<ProfileFieldPath, ProposedValue\> values,  
    List\<GenerationWarning\> warnings,  
    ProviderGenerationMetadata provider,  
    ProposalTrustState trustState  
) {}

## **B.7 Appearance selection**

record CosmeticSelectionContext(  
    CosmeticCategory primaryCategory,  
    CosmeticCategory secondaryCategory,  
    Optional\<String\> cosmeticId,  
    Optional\<String\> variantId,  
    Optional\<String\> colorOrGradientId,  
    int pageIndex,  
    String searchQuery  
) {}

## **B.8 Copied voice frame**

record CopiedOpusVoiceFrame(  
    long sequence,  
    long captureTimestampNanos,  
    byte\[\] opusPayload  
) {  
    CopiedOpusVoiceFrame {  
        opusPayload \= opusPayload.clone();  
    }  
}

## **B.9 Recording quality**

record VoiceDraftQualityReport(  
    Duration duration,  
    float peakAmplitude,  
    float clippingRatio,  
    float silenceRatio,  
    int missingSequenceCount,  
    int duplicateSequenceCount,  
    VoiceDraftValidity validity,  
    List\<VoiceQualityFinding\> findings  
) {}

## **B.10 Audit**

record NpcAuthoringAuditRecord(  
    UUID operationId,  
    UUID playerId,  
    UUID npcStableId,  
    AuthoringDomain domain,  
    String action,  
    Optional\<String\> beforeHash,  
    Optional\<String\> afterHash,  
    Instant timestamp,  
    AuthoringOperationResult result,  
    Optional\<String\> rejectionReason  
) {}

## **B.11 Core enums**

enum NpcAuthoringEditorKind { NONE, PROFILE, APPEARANCE, VOICE }

enum AuthoringSessionState {  
    CLOSED, OPENING, READY,  
    PROFILE\_EDIT, APPEARANCE\_EDIT, VOICE\_EDIT,  
    COMMITTING, DEGRADED, CLOSING  
}

enum ProposalTrustState {  
    GENERATED\_PROPOSAL,  
    GENERATED\_ACCEPTED\_DRAFT,  
    AUTHORED\_CANON\_GENERATED\_REVIEWED  
}

enum ItemMoveResultKind {  
    COMMITTED, REJECTED, NO\_OP, STALE, INVALID, DUPLICATE  
}

## **C.1 Normative layout relationships**

* Gear and Profile panels share a top baseline.  
* Coupled Inventory panel spans the combined top-panel width.  
* Gear left edge and Inventory left edge are flush.  
* Profile right edge and Inventory right edge are flush.  
* Inventory slots and gear slots remain square.  
* One contextual editor is visible at a time.  
* At 1920 x 1080 the contextual editor is centered foreground; at sufficiently wide resolutions it may dock right.  
* The transfer rail belongs inside the coupled Inventory frame.  
* The gold NPC background belongs behind the NPC preview, not behind the entire UI.

# **Appendix D. State and Event Matrix**

## **D.1 Workspace events**

| Event | From | To | Required action |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| OPEN\_STUDIO | CLOSED | OPENING | Resolve profile/NPC, permission, writer lease, revisions, containers |
| OPEN\_SUCCESS | OPENING | READY | Build page/windows, preview, summary, stats |
| OPEN\_FAILURE | OPENING | CLOSED | Release partial resources, readable failure |
| OPEN\_PROFILE\_EDITOR | READY | PROFILE\_EDIT | Create draft and editor generation |
| OPEN\_APPEARANCE\_EDITOR | READY | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Create skin draft and preview generation |
| OPEN\_VOICE\_RECORDER | READY | VOICE\_EDIT | Create recorder session, no capture yet |
| SWITCH\_EDITOR | Any editor | Target editor | Requires clean draft or Save/Discard |
| CLOSE\_STUDIO | READY/editor | CLOSING | Resolve dirty draft, invalidate, cleanup |
| CLOSE\_COMPLETE | CLOSING | CLOSED | Release writer lease and registry |
| NPC\_UNLOAD | READY/editor | DEGRADED | Disable live item/gear/stats; preserve safe drafts |

## **D.2 Profile events**

| Event | State | Behavior |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| FIELD\_CHANGED | PROFILE\_EDIT | Update draft field, dirty set, validation |
| GENERATE | PROFILE\_EDIT | Capture request identity/hash; schedule low-priority generation |
| GENERATION\_RESULT | PROFILE\_EDIT | Accept only matching generations/revision/hash; show proposal diff |
| ACCEPT\_PROPOSAL\_FIELD | PROFILE\_EDIT | Copy selected proposed value to draft with provenance |
| RESET\_PROFILE | PROFILE\_EDIT | Restore last persisted/saved revision |
| SAVE\_PROFILE | PROFILE\_EDIT | Enter COMMITTING; validate, conflict check, atomic save |
| SAVE\_PROFILE\_SUCCESS | COMMITTING | Refresh revisions/summary/caches; return READY or editor |
| SAVE\_PROFILE\_FAILURE | COMMITTING | Rollback/retain authority; keep draft open |
| CANCEL\_PROFILE | PROFILE\_EDIT | Discard after confirmation; return READY |

## **D.3 Appearance events**

| Event | State | Behavior |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| CATEGORY\_SELECTED | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Query cached page of catalog options |
| SEARCH\_CHANGED | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Debounce, cancel stale query, update option page |
| OPTION\_SELECTED | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Apply to draft copy, validate, increment preview generation |
| COLOR\_SELECTED | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Apply valid color/gradient to draft and preview |
| RANDOMIZE | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Generate/validate random draft; preserve reset snapshot |
| RESET\_APPEARANCE | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Restore persisted skin draft and preview |
| SAVE\_APPEARANCE | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Validate revision, atomic save, live apply |
| CANCEL\_APPEARANCE | APPEARANCE\_EDIT | Discard draft, restore authoritative preview |

## **D.4 Voice events**

| Event | From | Behavior / To |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| SELECT\_EMOTION | IDLE/READY/SAVED | Stop playback; select current sample |
| RECORD | IDLE/READY/SAVED | Acquire lease; enter ARMED |
| FIRST\_FRAME | ARMED | Enter RECORDING; start duration |
| STOP | RECORDING | Stop admission, release lease, enter FINALIZING |
| FINALIZE\_SUCCESS | FINALIZING | Create quality report/waveform; enter READY |
| FINALIZE\_FAILURE | FINALIZING | Discard invalid draft; enter FAILED |
| PLAY | READY/SAVED | Private playback; enter PLAYING |
| PLAY\_COMPLETE | PLAYING | Return READY/SAVED |
| DELETE\_DRAFT | READY | Discard unsaved audio; return IDLE/SAVED |
| SAVE\_SAMPLE | READY | Revision check, atomic save, rescan; enter SAVED |
| DELETE\_SAVED | SAVED | Confirm, atomic delete, rescan; return IDLE |
| CLOSE/DISCONNECT | Any | Stop, release, delete temp; enter CANCELLED |

## **D.5 Item events**

| Event | Context | Behavior |
| :---- | :---- | :---- |
| DROPPED | Any enabled item surface | Decode immutable intent; validate; one native transaction |
| QUICK\_MOVE | Selected stack | Validate selected source and target policy; smart move |
| HOVER/DRAG\_COMPLETE | Any | Observation/presentation only unless current bridge uses a proven reconciliation signal |
| DUPLICATE\_RELEASE | Any | Suppress, log, authoritative refresh |
| STALE\_SOURCE | Any | Reject, refresh, human-readable status |
| SESSION\_CLOSE | Any | Stop accepting intents before persistence flush |

# **Appendix E. Critical Acceptance Test Matrix**

| ID | Domain | Scenario | Expected result |
| :---- | :---- | :---- | :---- |
| E-001 | Session | Open same NPC from two players | Second writer rejected; no partial page |
| E-002 | Session | Rename display name during future reopen | Stable ID retains inventory, skin, voice, relationships |
| E-003 | Layout | 1920 x 1080 default scale | No overlap; slots square; editor centered |
| E-004 | Layout | 2560 x 1440 | Optional right dock; base workspace proportions preserved |
| E-005 | Inventory | Player \-\> NPC and NPC \-\> Player | Exact item/quantity/metadata; UI converges |
| E-006 | Inventory | Internal move, merge, split, swap | Native semantics; no manual arithmetic/write |
| E-007 | Inventory | Full destination and stale source | Reject; source retained; readable message |
| E-008 | Inventory | Close while dragging / duplicate event | No ghost item, double move, loss, or duplication |
| E-009 | Inventory | 100+ mixed operations | All counters zero; persistence stable |
| E-010 | Gear | Correct and incorrect armor slots | Correct accepts; incorrect rejects with evidence |
| E-011 | Gear | Occupied target and full destination | Atomic swap or clean rejection |
| E-012 | Loadout | Weapon/offhand/ammo dependency change | Revalidation; no silent deletion |
| E-013 | Stats | Equip armor | Authoritative Defense/stats refresh; live/preview parity |
| E-014 | Profile | Manual edit/save/reopen/restart | Exact canonical persistence and unknown-field retention |
| E-015 | Profile | Revision conflict | No overwrite; draft preserved |
| E-016 | Generate | Proposal accepted/rejected | No auto-save; only allowed fields; provenance |
| E-017 | Generate | Provider timeout/stale result | Manual draft intact; stale result discarded |
| E-018 | Canon | Generated unsaved text then talk to NPC | NPC does not know/use proposal |
| E-019 | Appearance | Change every category | Valid preview; no Player-avatar mutation |
| E-020 | Appearance | Cancel and Save | Cancel restores; Save persists/restarts |
| E-021 | Appearance | Asset pack removes saved cosmetic | Explicit missing state; no silent substitution |
| E-022 | Voice | Record Reference | Frames captured, processed, private playback, atomic save |
| E-023 | Voice | Record while conversation capture active | Deterministic lease behavior; no dual admission |
| E-024 | Voice | Close/disconnect while recording | Lease released, temp deleted, no save |
| E-025 | Voice | Playback draft | Private; no recapture, memory, or nearby broadcast |
| E-026 | Voice | Delete Reference | Strong confirmation; readiness updates |
| E-027 | Persistence | Injected write failure | Prior authority intact; temp quarantined/removed |
| E-028 | Identity | NPC despawns/reloads during editor | Live operations reject; no wrong entity mutation |
| E-029 | Security | Forged section/path/stable ID | Fail closed and log |
| E-030 | Integration | Create complete NPC in game then converse | Orbis uses saved profile and voice; item/appearance state correct |

## **E.1 Release counters**

| Counter | Required final value |
| :---- | :---- |
| Item loss | 0 |
| Item duplication | 0 |
| Wrong NPC/player/section/slot mutations | 0 |
| Uncleared cursor/ghost stack after completed action | 0 |
| Generated proposals committed without Save Profile | 0 |
| Player avatar mutations from NPC appearance editing | 0 |
| Voice frames admitted to both recorder and conversation | 0 |
| Raw audio/hidden reasoning leaked to logs | 0 |
| Stale async results applied | 0 |
| Partial authoritative files after failure | 0 |
| Unreleased writer/capture/preview/listener resources | 0 |

## **F.4 Source-use rules**

* Official Hytale APIs and the installed server/client build outrank community examples.  
* Current repository behavior and connected-client evidence outrank assumptions derived from public documentation.  
* Community code is not copied without license review.  
* Version-sensitive source facts are re-audited when Hytale updates.  
* Project mockups and UI assets communicate approved product direction but do not override authority or safety contracts.
